# Phase 5A.6: Ranking Revalidation

## Ranking revalidation protocol
- Universe: the exact same 538 Tier-1 matched pairs.
- Both sources use the same scalar functional and the same total piezo tensor contribution.
- Ties handled by stable argsort; near-zero values retained.
- Tensors compared after exact O(3) transport to a common frame.
